stopping_rule: Stop after fitting the selected pipeline (best mean 5-fold CV macro accuracy over 3 seeds on data/train) on all 300 training images; no further tuning.

hyperparams.features: HOG(cell=8)+HOG(cell=16) on grayscale, 4x4-grid Hellinger RGB color histogram (6^3 bins), 8x8 and 16x16 downsampled RGB
hyperparams.test_time_augmentation: average predict_proba of image and its horizontal flip
